items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: So I had recorded, you know, all the things with Pharoah Sanders, I recorded with Gato Barbieri, I was doing most all the Flying Dutchman records.

ctx.x: I guess waiting for opportunity because I was — I mean I just loved music. So I was playing, — when I left home I said I want to work with all the masters. And so I worked with Max, I worked with Art Blakey, and I think he did something with Mingus. So I met all of them, so when I was with Art Blakey I had a chance to hang out with Monk one night. Monk came down to hang out with Art, so I hung out with Monk and that was a pleasant surprise because you know everyone was saying Monk is so eccentric, but man, shoot,…

Miles I said oh boy, now I have arrived you know. Because Miles was the icing on the cake. But all before that Bob Thiele had Flying Dutchman Records. So I had recorded, you know, all the things with Pharoah Sanders, I recorded with Gato Barbieri, I was doing most all the Flying Dutchman records. So when I was with Miles Bob Thiele called me and said, “Lonnie, people are talking about you all over the world, so it’s time for you to do your own record.” I said okay, I’ll do my own record. So we did the record and…
